question: Which of GingaDaddy (gingadaddy.com), NzbNDX (nzbndx.com), Pirates4all (pirates4all.com/board) and NZBCat (nzb.cat) are reachable from a client that can pass a bot challenge or a different network path? gingadaddy.com served an SQL syntax error page through the broker and a 2014 data-crash notice on a direct read; nzbndx.com resolved but timed out twice (21 s); pirates4all.com answered HTTP 403 to a direct read and the broker; nzb.cat gave SERVFAIL with no reachable authority and is invite-only per the listings.
why: None of the four could be read first-party, so no record was drafted; each is listed with open or free registration by the indexer lists (NZBCat is invite-only), and a one-record run can settle them once a route exists.
